app.name: USB Loader GX
app.short_description: Load games from a USB or SD card
app.long_description:
USB Loader GX allows you to install your games to a USB storage device or SD card. You can then boot your games faster, download and use cheats, or apply various patches.
Home: https://github.com/wiidev/usbloadergx Support: https://gbatemp.net/threads/149922
